text: The Flight Vehicle Design and Engineering major integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as mechanics, materials science, electronics, and control science. It is a highly comprehensive discipline. It mainly conducts research in two directions: aviation (flight within the atmosphere) and aerospace (space flight). It involves the design of various types of aircraft, rockets, spacecraft, satellites, missiles, and probes. This major not only focuses on the external design and internal structure of the aircraft but also builds a power system and control system that enable the aircraft to fly smoothly. The precision requirements are extremely high, and even the slightest error is unacceptable.
